create_minigrid_env: create a MiniGrid gym environment with optional recording and CHW pixel format wrappers
rename_image_obs_wrapper: wrap a gym environment to rename the image observation key to obs
minigrid_recording_wrapper: wrap a MiniGrid environment to record episode frames and track cumulative rewards
render_minigrid_frame: render a MiniGrid environment frame as an RGB array and record it for video playback
step_minigrid_env: step a wrapped MiniGrid environment with an action and accumulate episode reward
